title: Fighting stances
description: Fighting stances: toggles a perk unlocks, each tied to what the hands hold (docs/core/combat.md#fighting-stances, GD_S05_02). At most one is active; its modifiers carry the martial origin, the source stance:<key>, and while_applied.

turn_start_ap.description: AP to take or change a stance at the start of the actor's own turn.

mid_turn_ap.description: AP to take or change a stance later in the turn.

parry_band_divisor.description: A parry band is floor(weapon skill / this).

main.description: The main hand it needs; any when left out.

off.description: The off hand it needs; any when left out.

main_skills.description: The main-hand weapon must use one of these skills; any when left out.

off_skills.description: The off-hand weapon must use one of these skills; any when left out.

modifiers.description: What the stance does while active: origin core:origin/martial, source stance:<key>, duration while_applied.
